en.title: Maximize XOR with Limited Set Bits
en.description:
Given a fixed-length binary string x, construct a binary string y of the same length containing at most maxSet 1s so that the unsigned value of x XOR y is maximized. Output y; leading 0s are allowed.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains bits maxSet, and the second line contains x. The source gives no numeric bounds; on this site 1≤bits≤100000, 0≤maxSet≤bits.
en.output: Output the binary string y of the same length.
hints: Starting from the most significant bit, set y to 1 only where x is 0 and you still have set-bit budget left; all other bits are 0.
